title: Normal (tricky): the real grandson asks for a ride, and gas money comes up

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hey Grandma, it's Danny! How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Danny! I'm good, sweetheart. How's school?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good! Hey, my car's at the shop till Thursday. Could you pick me up after practice tomorrow at four?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thanks! Mom said she'll give you twenty dollars for gas on Sunday. I'll text her that you're picking me up.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Don't worry about the gas. See you tomorrow.
